# Design Guide

<!-- Generated by CodePress style analysis. -->

SECTION 1: Primary Styling System
‣ Brand feel / mood: Minimal Create-React-App demo page for a tiny loader library — centered layout, dark header bar, and bright accent colors (red, green, purple) used to showcase the loader's flexibility rather than enforce a brand.
‣ One-word system: CSS-Modules — actually, plain global CSS via per-component imports (`App.css`, `Watermark.css`, `index.css`); written as classic stylesheets with hand-authored class names like `.App-header`, `.bodyContainer`, `.optionTextInput`. No CSS Modules, no Tailwind, no CSS-in-JS.
‣ Breakpoints found in the repo: None defined. No media queries exist in `App.css`, `Watermark.css`, or `index.css`. Unknown.

SECTION 2: Other Styling Signals
‣ Plain global CSS files imported into components: ~100%.
‣ Inline styles in JSX: 0% — no `style={{}}` usage in `App.js` or `DotDotDotLoader.js`.
‣ CSS-in-JS / Sass / Tailwind: 0% — no `tailwind.config.*`, no `.scss`, no styled-components dependency.
‣ Evidence: `import './App.css';` in `src/App.js:3`
‣ Evidence: `.App-header { background-color: #222; height: 150px; padding: 20px; color: white; }`
‣ Evidence: `font-family: Roboto Mono, monospace; font-weight: 500;` in `src/Watermark.css`

SECTION 3: Repo-Level UI Context
‣ Framework: React (^16.0.0), class components, `react-dom`.
‣ Language split: JavaScript only (`.js` / `.jsx`); no TypeScript, no `tsconfig.json`.
‣ UI libraries: None. No shadcn/ui, Radix, MUI, or Bootstrap. Font Awesome is loaded via CDN `<script>` in `public/index.html` but not used in components.
‣ Pre-processors / CSS-in-JS: None. Plain `.css` files only. `postcss-loader` + `postcss-flexbugs-fixes` + `autoprefixer` are present in the CRA-style webpack build but no custom PostCSS plugins.
‣ State libraries: None. Local `this.state` in React class components only — no redux, zustand, recoil, react-query.
‣ Color palette:
  - Header / dark surface: `#222` (`.App-header` background) with `white` text.
  - Accent red: `#e53030` (`.redStyle`).
  - Accent green: `#63ba1b` (`.greenStyle`).
  - Accent purple: `#a22dbc` (`.dotStyle`).
  - Accent pink: `#ff0084` (`.deploy` in `Watermark.css`).
  - Toggle on-state blue: `#2196F3` (`.slider` checked).
  - Toggle off-state grey: `#ccc`.
  - Neutral text: `#000` (`.watermark`, `.hello`), `white` on dark header.
  - Tokens live as raw hex literals inside `src/App.css` and `src/Watermark.css`. No CSS custom properties, no SCSS vars, no Tailwind config.
‣ Typography:
  - Body font: `sans-serif` (system fallback) from `body { font-family: sans-serif; }` in `src/index.css`.
  - Display / mono font: `Roboto Mono, monospace` loaded from Google Fonts in `public/index.html` and used only in `.watermark`.
  - Scale: hand-picked px / em values — `.App-title` `1.5em`, `.optionTextInput` `18px`, `.redStyle` `20px`, `.dotStyle` `100px`. No formal type scale.
  - Conventions: `.deploy` and `.hello` use `text-transform: uppercase`; `.watermark` uses `font-weight: 500`.
‣ Spacing & layout:
  - Spacing scale: ad-hoc px values — recurring `20px`, `30px`, `50px` margins/paddings; no token system.
  - Container widths: `.bodyContainer` is `100%`; `.inputContainer` is `50%`; `.textContainer` is `60%`. No `max-width`.
  - Primitives: Flexbox via `display: flex`, `flex-direction: column`, `justify-content: space-around`, `align-items: center`. `box-sizing: border-box` applied per-rule. No CSS grid, no gap utilities.
‣ Shape & elevation:
  - Corner radius: only on the toggle — `border-radius: 34px` for `.slider.round` (pill) and `50%` for its `:before` thumb. Other elements are square.
  - Elevation: flat. No `box-shadow` other than a 1px focus ring `box-shadow: 0 0 1px #2196F3` on `.slider:focus`. Borders are used for separation: `.textContainer { border: 1px solid; }`.
‣ Component patterns:
  - Number input: `<input className="optionTextInput" type="number" />` styled as `.optionTextInput { height: 34px; width: 170px; font-size: 18px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 5px; }` — square, no border declared (UA default).
  - Toggle switch: nested `<label className="switch"><input type="checkbox"/><span className="slider round"/></label>`; `.switch` is `70px × 34px`, `.slider` is grey `#ccc` off / blue `#2196F3` on, 26px white thumb translated `36px` on check.
  - Surface card: `.textContainer { border: 1px solid; width: 60%; padding: 20px; text-align: left; }` — single hairline border on a centered block, no radius, no shadow.
  - Header bar: `.App-header { background-color: #222; height: 150px; padding: 20px; color: white; }` containing a spinning SVG logo (`animation: App-logo-spin infinite 20s linear;`) and `.App-title { font-size: 1.5em; }`.

SECTION 4: Guidance for Downstream LLM
‣ Do write styles in plain global `.css` files next to the component (e.g., add a new `Foo.css` and `import './Foo.css'` from `Foo.js`); don't introduce Tailwind, CSS Modules, Sass, or styled-components — none are configured.
‣ Do reuse the existing accent hexes (`#e53030`, `#63ba1b`, `#a22dbc`, `#ff0084`) and the `#222` dark header; don't invent new palette values or CSS custom properties — the repo has no token layer.
‣ Do lay out with Flexbox and percentage widths (`width: 50%`, `display: flex`, `justify-content: space-around`) the way `.bodyContainer` and `.inputContainer` do; don't add CSS grid or media queries — no breakpoints exist in the codebase.
‣ Do keep surfaces flat: a single `border: 1px solid` like `.textContainer`, no `box-shadow` beyond the existing 1px focus hint; don't add new elevation levels or rounded corners outside the pill toggle pattern.
‣ Do use `sans-serif` for body copy and reserve `Roboto Mono, monospace` for watermark-style accents; don't load additional webfonts — only Roboto Mono is linked in `public/index.html`.
‣ Do write React class components with local `this.state` matching `App.js` and `DotDotDotLoader.js`; don't pull in hooks-only patterns, redux, or any state library — none are dependencies.
